name: Tempest
effect: Everyone moves 20% faster, and every 20 seconds lightning lights the whole realm for a second.

name: Deep sleep
effect: Every 20 seconds each guard dozes for 3 seconds; flowers muffle footsteps.

name: Ghost tide
effect: Knocked-out characters drift back to where they entered the realm instead of being caught.

name: Fair lights
effect: Floating lights form illusions of crew members that draw guards away.

name: Iron bell
effect: Every step echoes: guards hear 2 tiles further but see 2 tiles less.

name: Mirage
effect: Anything moving appears one tile from where it really is.

name: Clockwork
effect: Every 15 seconds all wards in the realm trigger together.

name: Wild hunt
effect: Anyone running makes no noise at all.

name: Hidden garden
effect: Tall grass spreads one tile a minute across the realm.

name: Lantern festival
effect: Lanterns heal anyone in their light and revive each character once.

name: Quicksand
effect: A few tiles become hidden pits that drop anyone a level.

name: Rebound
effect: Every stun bounces on to the nearest enemy.
